book.name: LUKE
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Luke wana Leleli

content: Gegi, Abulilek ge Totuwalali Baliya
Yeisu i baek wana tohago eliyalil i ba, “Tunahot ta atena te bugul bolo gamagalau hi pagegel nihi masamasal, yaa henala toto ali topapamasal, he ana lahi ni bwata.

Binimala pat pupulowanina ta gimwan mwamwalinaa ge ta alipalo hogaa, he lahi o nige i bwabwata hot. Yaa Yehoba lahi bwabwatana hot ni pek elana, ebo tokekeisi etegana ni pagegi ge ni sogu, tokekeisi ololana wawaya ya.
He nuku matahikagimiu. “Ebo talim ni gegi, he nu baek elana nu ba, ‘Bahi nu giginol ola to,’ ge ebo ni ba, ‘Soli. Tunahot ya gegi to,’ he inoke wana gegi nu nuwayoho.
Ebo lan maisena gamwanaa paseben ni gegi eliyam, ge ebo ni sikaliwa paseben ge ni ba, ‘Soli. Ya gegi to,’ he wana gegi nu nuwayoho.”
Apostolowau hi baek Babala elana hi ba, “Wama abulilek u pwabwaya.”

Analiya i lahe i ba, “Ebo wami abulilek i gan, bwagana wana kekeisisi ni ola ebwakil toto masted pwatumwina, bosowaimiu nuku baek kalehe ya elana nuku ba, ‘Totom u pulutiwa ge u na u talmilil hogaa,’ yaka ni ginol ola wami baaba.

“Binimala ebo komiu etega wana totuwalali loloyowanina etega ni gan, ge ni patuna ni na ni tuwalali eyowaa, o ebo sipi ni matahikagil. Sauga ni sikalim limiya, tab nasi wana tonowak ni baek elana ni ba, ‘U nem hiwe u misiyo ge u anan’?
He nigeya. Yaa ni baek elana ni ba, ‘Au nu ligaliga, yaka kaliko waiwaisana nu galoi, ge au nu ginol nu pwatanim na anan ge na imwim. Yaka abwe mulaa owa nu anan ge nu imwim.’
Tonowak nige ni babaa mulolu wana totuwalali elana kaiwena tuwalali i ginol i ola ana logugui.
He i ola al te komiu, sauga ebo tuwalali toto Yehoba i pewa eliyamiu nuku ginol haba, inoke nuku ba, ‘Bahi nuku totobalagima. Ama totuwalali ya, he tuwalali ya te ha ginol i ola ama logugui.’”
Tolepelo Ali Gewi Elulutega Yeisu I Pwamolol
Sauga Yeisu i nanawa Yelusalema kaiwena, i noek labi Sameliya ge labi Galili ali siga elana.
Kelaubwa ni vin awan etega elana, yaka tolepelo elulutega hi pwawaa to. Hi talmililek laha,
inoke hi yoga analiya i bwata hi ba, “Tonowak Yeisu, u atilomwan-agima!”
Sauga i kitel, yaka i baek elal i ba, “Ku nok, ku na topowon elal tuwamiu nihi hile.”
Hi nawanawa kamwasaa inoke ali lepelo i mowasi.
Aloliya etegana, sauga tuwana i kite i waisi, inoke i sikal i nonotobatobal Yehoba elana anana i bwata.
I na i loepwakokuwa Yeisu aenaa ge maninina i pahanalowanek bilibiliya, yaka i ba mulolu elana. He tau o iya Sameliya gamagalina.
Yeisu i ba, “Bolau elulutega te ali lepelo i mowasi. He ali toto naen al heliya ga?
Ga i ola ge tau ya, iya nige Yudiya gamagalina i oola, maisena ya i nosikalim ge i ba mulolu Yehoba elana?”
Inoke i baek tau elana i ba, “U milil ge u egon; wam abulilek i pwamolowa.”
Yehoba wana Abalogugui wana Nem Bana
Boda Palisi hi nel Yeisu elana hi ba, “Hauna sauga ge Yehoba wana abalogugui ni nem?” Analiya i lahe i ba, “Yehoba wana abalogugui wana nem nige ni oola tage gamagalau nihi kiteya mataliyaa.
Nige nihi babaa, ‘Ku kite, iya hiwe’, o ebo ‘Iya huwo,’ kaiwena Yehoba wana abalogugui iyahe i minaa eliyamiu.”
Yaka i baek wana tohago elal i ba, “Ana sauga abwe ni vin inoke nuwamiu hot Gamagal Natuna wana sauga logugui ana lan etega nuku kite, yaa nige nuku kikite.
Gamagalau nihi baewa eliyamiu nihi ba, ‘Ku kite, iya huwo,’ o ebo ‘Iya hiwe.’ Yaa bahi nuku tatauliulil eliyaa.
Kaiwena Gamagal Natuna wana nem ni ola pinamal, toto i pinamalek hawawala yaka mwananalina labulabum i yane, i telipunaa labi etega ge i na labi etega al.
Yaa houwan ga lomwan ni pwawa nabiyan, ge heyan bolo sauga ya nihi towani.
I ola valila Nowa wana sauga eliyana, he nasi ni ola al Gamagal Natuna wana nem ana sauga eliyana.
Saugena o gamagalau hi aanan, hi loloimwim, hi loloalalolon, hi olaola ya to ana siga Nowa i na i ulutuk waga gamwanaa. Inoke nub i ha ge gegewel hi aliga haba.
He pagan maisena o i gan al Lote wana sauga elana. Gamagalau hi aanan, hi loloimwim, hi lolopwapwamola, hi lolopalipali, hi loloeyeyowa, ge limi hi lolotaltal.
Yaa lan toto Lote Sodoma i lou luwan, inoke Yehoba ginaha alona ge pat salpa kalakalasina i ligin lowanem labulabumwa i ola kehe ge gamagalau gegewel hi aliga haba.
He nasi ni ola to, lan toto Gamagal Natuna ni masal.

Lan o eliyana, ebo gamagal etega iyoho wana limi pwatanaa toto hi tal paabwab elana, ge ebo wana bugubugul iyoho limi gamwanaa, he bahi ni lalau ni uulutuk ge ni aahe, ni lou ya. I ola al ebo gamagal etega iyoho i tuwatuwalali eyowaa, bahi ni sisikal panuwaa.
Nuku nuwatu pagan toto i masala Lote lagona elana.
Henala ebo ni labose yawalina ni pwamwal, nasi ni payaomal, ge henala ebo yawalina ni payaomal, nasi yawalina ni pwamwal.
Na baewa eliyamiu, bulin o elana gamagalau labui abakenu maisena elana nihi kenuwa, etegana nihi ahe egonan, etegana ni mina.
Yowau labui nihi tuwalali toyawa witi enona nihi wowowol, etegana nihi ahe egonan, etegana ni mina.
Bolau labui nihi tuwatuwalali eyowaa, etegana nihi ahe egonan, etegana ni mina.”
Yaka tohago hi nel Yeisu elana hi ba, “Babala, hauna labi elana ge bugul bolo ya nihi masala?” Analiya i lahe i ba, “Ebo bweyan ga i minaa, inoke okok nihi na ge nihi tagul pwehik.”
